anonymous voice of the Gemara: asks מאי ארץ כבול (54a.3)

props.gloss_en: Rav Huna: [it is called the land of Kavul] because there were people in it bound up (mechubalin) in silver and gold
as it is written: 'and they were not right in his eyes' (I Kings 9:12)
Rav Huna: yes -- since they are rich and pampered, they do not do work [and so the cities were not right in his eyes]
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: it was a land of chomton
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: and why is it called kavul? because the leg sinks into it up to the ankle (kavla)
and people say: 'bound land' -- that does not bear fruit

supports.gloss_en: ואמרי אינשי: ארעא מכבלתא דלא עבדא פירי -- common speech calls land that bears no fruit 'bound'

objections.gloss_en: אי הכי, היינו דכתיב ולא ישרו בעיניו -- מפני שמכובלין בכסף ובזהב לא ישרו בעיניו? -- if so, because they were bound up in silver and gold they were not right in his eyes?

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר ליה: אין, כיון דעתירי ומפנקי לא עבדי עבידתא -- yes: being rich and pampered, they do not do work (= p_atirei_umefankei)
